name: deepseek-code-agent
description: Delegate bounded work to local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) by default, with an explicit legacy OpenCode/Luna lane.

interface.shortDescription: Default local DSH worker with an explicit legacy OpenCode lane.
interface.longDescription: Runs bounded coding, review, testing and browser work in a persistent local DeepSeek Harness session by default, with scoped context, corrections, pending questions, interruption and the current-Chrome huashu bridge. The older OpenCode ds_* controller remains available only when explicitly selected.
defaultPrompt: Delegate bounded implementation to local DSH with DeepSeek Flash and max reasoning, then review the result.
Use DSH to investigate and fix this repo, including tests, then report changed files and checks.
Use the legacy OpenCode ds_* lane only because I explicitly asked for it.
